headline: As of 2026-10-06: 1,413,542 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 31 of 50 states, D+31.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,413,542 early/mail ballots cast so far across 31 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+31.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (387,232), Florida (221,233), New Jersey (178,984).
